description: GEOLib is a Deltares Python package for generating, running and parsing numerical models from the D-Serie and D-GEO Suite. It supplies a programmable interface around model files and separate console executables. Users prepare geotechnical model inputs, invoke an installed solver and read results back into their workflow. Coverage is global and project-specific, with discretisation and analysis period determined by the underlying model. Public package source, pip installation and environment documentation are free under MIT. A limitation is that the external numerical executables must be obtained separately from Deltares or an existing suite installation, with their own access and licence conditions. GEOLib therefore does not provide unrestricted solver access merely because its wrapper is open. It can support repeated ground, foundation or flood-defence analyses and complements hydraulic modelling with Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The README also documents a reproducible development environment and tests. No solver was installed, model generated or numerical result reproduced.
